paragraphs.text: Smith is a obsolete class . Smiths are craftspeople who fashion useful items (for example, tools, jewelry, armor, and weapons) out of various metals.

The two cards with the subtype Smith were Hyperion Blacksmith and Repentant Blacksmith . These were changed to Artificer in the Grand Creature Type Update . Since then, there have been numerous Smith related cards, which are usually typed as Artificers.
Ayesha Tanaka , armorer
Koll , the forgemaster
Nazahn , Revered Bladesmith
Purphoros , the God of the Forge on Theros .
Toggo , Goblin Weaponsmith
Thousand Moons Smithy
Most types of Smiths are Artificers though there are a few exceptions.
No Specialization : a general all-around smith. Example: Ingenious Smith
Armorsmith : a smith who specializes in armor. Example: Veteran Armorsmith
Blacksmith : a metalsmith who creates objects primarily from wrought iron or steel, but sometimes from other metals. Example: Argivian Blacksmith
Bladesmith : a smith who specializes in blades. Example: Nazahn, Revered Bladesmith
Coinsmith : a smith who specializes in coins. Example: Underworld Coinsmith
Embersmith : Vulshok artificer smiths “The Vulshok see the artificer as a catalyst, bringing the spark of creation that ignites change.”
Gearsmith : smiths who create machinery with gears. Example: Gearsmith Prodigy , Restoration Gearsmith
Ironsmith : a smith who specializes in creating with iron. Example: Village Ironsmith
Lifesmith : Sylvok artificer smiths. “The Sylvok see the artificer as a gardener, preparing the world for hardy growth.”
Lightsmith : a Cleric who imbues light into objects. One of the few non-Artificer smiths. Example: Dwarven Lightsmith
Locksmith : a smith rogue that specializes in locks. One of the few non-Artificer smiths. Example: Goblin Locksmith
Myrsmith : Auriok artificer smiths. “The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.”
Painsmith : Moriok artificer smiths. “ The Moriok see the artificer as a taskmaster, forcing lazy metal into more potent shapes.”
Quicksmith : smiths who rely on flashes of inspiration rather than careful research. Examples: Quicksmith Genius , Quicksmith Rebel , Quicksmith Spy
Riddlesmith : Neurok artificer smiths. “ The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.”
Silversmith : a metalsmith who specializes in using Silver. Example: Gavony Silversmith
Sliversmith : A type of Spellshaper that created artifact Slivers . One of the few non-Artificer smiths.
Sparksmith : goblin tinkerer One of the few non-Artificer smiths.
Swordsmith : a smith who specializes in swords. Example: Pardic Swordsmith , Taj-Nar Swordsmith , Veteran Swordsmith
Weaponsmith : a smith that specializes in weapons. Example: Dwarven Weaponsmith , Renowned Weaponsmith , Viashino Weaponsmith
Wheelsmith : Pilot smiths who specialize in vehicles . One of the few non-Artificer smiths.
Wingsmith : a smith who specializes in artificial wings. Example: Weldfast Wingsmith
